What I Do

How I Can Help Your Business

Building Products

I will build that AI product you don't have the bandwidth for. From AI-powered features and custom LLM pipelines to working prototypes. I work with founders and leaders, integrate with the dev team or work alone, use your stack or build whatever is needed from scratch.

Getting the Team Up to Speed

I will lead group sessions to drive excitement and engagement across the organization. I will help you identify the people who will lead the change and work with them 1:1 to get them up to speed on techniques and tools. I will do this for development teams as well as other business units.

Shaping the Organization

I will help review your processes and see what can be improved with AI. I will help you build the processes and pipelines you need, and I will train your team to be able to keep this momentum with self service tools.

Shaping Business Strategy

I will work with leadership to find where AI creates new business opportunities, where it creates new threats, and then turn that into a clear, prioritized roadmap tied to business outcomes.
